800.$description: Decorative dividers on dark surfaces (white at 10% on navy-900, flattened).

900.$description: Brand navy. The one text colour (decision 20).

500.$description: Brand gold. Fills and accents on light backgrounds; text only on navy.

700.$description: Error. oklch(50% 0.18 25), from the portfolio's contact form.
Success. oklch(45% 0.15 140), from the portfolio's CV modal.

text.$description: All text: headings, body, labels, links, eyebrows, metric numbers. The only main text colour (decision 20). On a dark surface it becomes color-text-on-dark.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text: captions, meta, hints. 4.85:1 or better on every light background. On a dark surface it becomes color-text-muted-on-dark.

text-placeholder.$description: Input placeholders (decision 19). Forms appear only on light surfaces.

text-emphasis.$description: Gold italic words in headings (decision 18). Allowed only in display, title and heading, the roles that never go below 24px (decision 28). Never in subheading, card-title or text roles: at 3.5–3.8:1 on the beige backgrounds (4.3:1 on white) it passes AA only as large text. On a dark surface it becomes color-text-emphasis-on-dark.

text-on-action.$description: Text on color-action and color-action-hover. On a dark surface, where the action turns gold, it becomes color-text-on-accent.

text-on-accent.$description: Text on gold fills (color-accent, color-action-on-dark). Always navy, on every surface: sand on gold is 1.6:1.

surface-subtle.$description: Alternate sections, e.g. the contact section.

surface-highlight.$description: Background of the light Highlight (pull quotes, insight callouts). Also marks a highlighted area, e.g. a chart quadrant. Text on it: color-text 9.32:1, color-text-muted 4.89:1.

surface-dark.$description: Every dark background: dark sections, the footer and the dark Highlight block (decision 30). Apply it with the .fds-surface-dark class, which also switches the text, decorative border, rule, focus and action roles inside it.

border.$description: Decorative dividers only. 1.3:1, too faint for anything a user must see: use color-border-input for inputs. On a dark surface it becomes color-border-on-dark.

border-input.$description: Resting input underlines. 3.36:1 on background, 3.78 on surface, 3.10 on surface-subtle (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1). Inputs appear only on light surfaces.

border-strong.$description: Focused or active input underline. A state, not decoration: use color-border-rule for decorative lines. Forms appear only on light surfaces.

border-rule.$description: Decorative strong lines: eyebrow rules, card top rules, the reading progress bar. Same value as color-border-strong, different role. On a dark surface it becomes color-border-rule-on-dark.

border-highlight.$description: The light Highlight's left rule. Decorative (decision 31): 2.06:1 on color-surface-highlight.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. On a dark surface it becomes color-focus-on-dark.

action.$description: Primary button background, including case-study buttons such as View prototype. On a dark surface it becomes color-action-on-dark (gold), so the button never disappears.

action-hover.$description: Primary button hover. On a dark surface it becomes color-action-hover-on-dark.

accent.$description: Brand gold fill: accent button background, secondary-link underline. Text on it: color-text-on-accent. Not a text colour on light backgrounds.

error.$description: The only error colour: field errors, invalid underlines, error messages. 5.88:1 on background, 6.61 on surface, 5.42 on surface-subtle. Light surfaces only: 1.70:1 on color-surface-dark.

success.$description: The only success colour. 6.27:1 on background, 7.06 on surface, 5.79 on surface-subtle. Light surfaces only: 1.60:1 on color-surface-dark.

5.$description: Paragraph spacing in case studies, grid gaps.

16.$description: Large blocks, e.g. the next-project block.

30.$description: Hero top padding. The largest fixed step.

sm.$description: Small inline blocks: pull quotes, metrics, pain points. Never buttons.

lg.$description: Every card (text and image), images, banners and modals.

pill.$description: Every button, tag and chip. No square buttons.

sm.$description: Hover on small text cards. navy-900 at 7%.

md.$description: Hover on text cards; floating banners. navy-900 at 10%.

lg.$description: Hover on image cards. navy-900 at 30%.

overlay.$description: Modals: the one element above everything else. navy-900 at 30%.

ring-width.$description: Width of the keyboard focus ring. Focus is always this ring in color-focus, never a shadow.

ring-offset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.
